breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies the boundary layer as turbulent at Re_x = 2.0×10^6 (which is well above the ~5×10^5 transition threshold) and uses the turbulent correlation δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^(-1/5) instead of the laminar formula δ = 5x/√Re_x. This matches the ground truth's approach.
